title: Cane Creek Goes Cold Blooded with eeBrakes Gecko
content:
Gecko is the latest limited drop from Cane Creek’s eeBrakes line. Cane Creek has released several limited-edition eeBrakes per year since 2017, each in very small quantities. The brakes have become a favorite for custom builders and enthusiasts looking to add character, unrivaled craftsmanship, and stopping power to their bikes. This limited drop is dubbed “Gecko” but looks more like a Red Eyed Tree Frog (Agalychnis callidryas) if you ask us! With bright green and orange anodizing, these limited editions won’t last long.

Check ’em out at Cane Creek!
